verdict.rationale: Omnara documents configurable approval gates, letting you choose which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask for input. That could gate repository-modifying actions. There is no evidence of a workflow for reviewing and approving a task's scope or contract up front. missing for 10: explicit pre-execution scope/contract (spec) approval step, a repo-write-specific gating example, detailed docs on the approval configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
